warrant_soundness.evidence: Each unit explains why the catalog structure supports the stated domain role or integration consequence; no warrant merely repeats its claim.

mece_coverage.evidence: The five components separate domain boundaries, risk inputs, realized impacts, adaptation and MEL, and cross-domain integration without substantive duplication.

application_grounded.evidence: Each proposed report section follows from the corresponding evidence and warrant in the map.

section_job.evidence: Sections 1–6 explain the CDM through domains, data entities, and relationships without introducing physical-schema attributes or SQL.

audience_decision_value.evidence: The summary and section 6 identify how the catalog supports data governance, logical modeling, APIs, quality rules, traceability, and adaptation reporting.

evidence_payload.evidence: The report records 8 domains, all 45 data entities, all 51 numbered relationships, their cardinalities, and the central integration mechanisms.

causal_logic.evidence: Sections 3–5 connect climate inputs to hazard products, risk outputs, realized impacts, adaptation decisions, and MEL results without reversing cause and effect.

argument_fidelity.evidence: Warrant trace finds all five approved units present, with term overlap from 71% to 100%; manual review confirms each claim and design application is represented.

reader_facing_appropriateness.evidence: The report contains no prompt residue, internal page locators, or drafting commentary; source filenames appear only in the scope statement to establish evidence precedence.

terminology_agency.evidence: Thai prose consistently uses 'โดเมนข้อมูล' and 'หน่วยข้อมูล', while Domain_ID, Entity_Name, key types, and cardinalities remain in their catalog forms.

source_fidelity.evidence: Automated coverage checks found 45 of 45 Entity_Name values and 51 numbered relationship rows; domain counts total 45 and match the source catalogs.

form_readability.evidence: The information is divided into a domain overview, eight entity tables, five grouped relationship tables, cross-domain synthesis, and implementation implications.

findings.issue: The report is table-dense because the approved contract requires complete coverage of 45 data entities and 51 relationships.
findings.disposition: Retain the tables as technical reference material; surrounding prose provides the interpretive layer.
